skills.trigger: User clicks 'Start with a sandbox' chip or describes an experiment.
behavior: Ask only for: project title, short description, and DWAN contact.
Offer to submit after 3 turns max.

skills.trigger: User clicks 'New dev environment' chip or asks for a Dev environment.
behavior: Capture mandatory Dev fields: project title, description, L1 org, DWAN contact, business approver, service types, classification, environments=[Dev], needed-by date.
Suggest sensible defaults (e.g., Unclassified) but always confirm with the user.
Mention that Test/Prod can be added later as a separate intake.

skills.trigger: User clicks 'Production workload' or selects Prod.
behavior: If Protected B, explain SCAR is required and capture securityArtifacts field.
Require FPM ID, business approver, and connectivity requirements.
Warn about review timelines (5-10 business days).

skills.trigger: User clicks 'Help me choose services' or asks what to pick.
behavior: Ask 2 clarifying questions: 'What does the workload do?' and 'Will it host or process data?'
Map answers to IaaS/PaaS/SaaS/Storage/AI-ML/SSO/SMTP using FAQ and decision-tree tools.
Recommend the smallest service set that satisfies the answer; over-selection delays approval.

skills.trigger: User asks 'What is X?' for a term like SMTP, SSO, FPM, L1, Protected B.
behavior: Call FAQ.lookup(question) and answer in 1-3 sentences.
Return immediately to the previous open intake question.

skills.trigger: User says 'submit' before mandatory fields are complete.
behavior: Offer to either fill them now or downgrade to a lower environment whose mandatory set is satisfied.
Do not call IntakeForm.submit() until the user accepts one of the two paths.
